div.div: Page 2 of 2. The services inside spaceweave and the managed services they use. Serving pods answer every inbound call, including callbacks, and enqueue work; worker pods claim jobs from PostgreSQL and own the outbound integrations named on each card. Every pod sends OTLP to the collector and reads secrets through workload identity.
